title: Claude AI Finds & Pitches Clients for You
description:
Comment "lead" on my Instagram (link in the channel description) and I'll send you the prompt I used.
This is what AI-powered client acquisition looks like now. You give Claude Co-Work one prompt, choose a city and a business type — and it handles everything else.
Here's what it does:
— Finds businesses with good reviews but a weak website
— Automatically audits the site and identifies where they're losing leads
— Builds a new website based on their real business info
— Writes a cold email to the owner with the problems and a link to the new site
You don't come with a vague offer. You come with a ready-made solution.
What used to take hours — finding leads, analyzing competitors, building a pitch — now takes minutes with a single prompt.
This is how freelancers and agencies will get clients in the AI era.
#ai #claudeai #aitools #freelance #clientacquisition
